levels.name: Ladybug Meadow
levels.about: Every number has its dots beside it, so your child can count to check. Higher and lower start here.

levels.name: Bunny Burrow
levels.about: Dots in a ten-frame (two rows of five) show how big each number is.

levels.name: Fishy Pond
levels.about: Comparing teen numbers with the numbers below ten.

levels.name: Rocket Ridge
levels.about: Twenties and thirties. Pip’s hint shows the middle when the line gets long.

levels.name: Treasure Island
levels.focus: Numbers 1 to 50, on the number pad
levels.about: Typing two-digit numbers. Starting in the middle (25) finds the number fastest.

levels.name: Star Castle
levels.about: Start in the middle and halve what’s left each time: any number from 1 to 100 can be found in 7 guesses.
